review_method: Read captured first-party titles, metadata, visible workflow text, and selected follow-up pages. Approval establishes only public product identity and advertised AI-assisted workflow, not working functionality, small-company status, adoption, or commercial value.

explicit_exclusions.Outranking: Official static captures describe AI SEO software but do not visibly establish the product brand. Excluded conservatively pending stronger brand-domain evidence.
explicit_exclusions.Saleshandy: Identity is visible, but bounded homepage/pricing captures do not substantiate the AI-assisted workflow. Not treated as nonexistent.
explicit_exclusions.Fin: HTTP 200 capture contains no extractable title, metadata, or workflow text. HTTP success is not identity verification.
explicit_exclusions.Clockwise: Official page states product no longer available from March 27, 2026. Excluded as discontinued rather than treating historical capabilities as an active service.
explicit_exclusions.Taploop: Directory describes AI marketing operator, but linked first-party domain now presents a subscription marketplace. Conflicting identity/workflow evidence retained; excluded.
explicit_exclusions.TalaForge: Verified AI companion identity, but principal consumer relationship workflow falls outside the ten business/productivity strata. Excluded from this discovery frame, not a commercial rejection.
explicit_exclusions.FlipWorth: Official capture describes resale valuation but does not establish an AI-assisted workflow. Pending additional evidence.

default_unapproved_reason: Public request failed or no reviewed first-party evidence supports eligibility. See capture error. Not proof of nonexistence or business failure.
